content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Stripe offers a comprehensive suite of features for digital creators, including payment processing, subscription management, and analytics, but its limited availability in 46 countries out of 195 means that many creators are left without access. PayPal, on the other hand, offers a broad range of services, including online payment processing, money transfers, and invoicing, but its account suspension policies can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy provide alternatives to these platforms, but their restrictions on digital sellers in certain countries are well-documented, making it difficult for creators to find a reliable platform for selling plugins. Meanwhile, Paddle has made strides in offering a more inclusive platform for digital creators, but its fees and restrictions can be steep for some sellers. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a comprehensive solution for digital creators, providing a sovereign digital commerce stack that includes payment processing, order storage, and file delivery, all while giving creators full ownership and control over their infrastructure.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe's limited availability in certain countries is well-documented, and many creators have been left without access to its services. PayPal's account suspension policies can also result in funds being held for up to 180 days with no appeal, a reality that is particularly concerning for creators who rely on a steady stream of income from their plugin sales. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy have faced criticism for their restrictions on digital sellers in certain countries, and Paddle's fees and restrictions can be steep for some sellers. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a solution for creators in restricted countries, allowing them to sell plugins online without relying on a platform that may not have their best interests at heart.

Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also charge fees for their services, including transaction fees and payment processing fees. Meanwhile, Paddle charges a flat fee of 5% + $0.30 per transaction, which can be steep for some sellers. In contrast, NOWPayments, the payment processing solution included in COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197), charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, making it a more cost-effective option for creators who sell plugins online.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe and PayPal require creators to relinquish ownership of their customer data, which can be a major concern for those who value their customer relationships. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also collect customer data, which can be used for marketing and other purposes. Meanwhile, Paddle charges a premium for its services, which can include automation and delivery features, but these features can come at a cost. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides creators with full ownership and control over their customer data, automation, and delivery, allowing them to build strong relationships with their customers and deliver their plugins with confidence.
